note: Champion (008): single tile, reactive skip-and-remember, walk on every miss. 04:49.565, rank #302, ~55.8 hay/tick. 009 probed a reroll-before-walk hybrid (miss's true hit rate is only 1/3 per 004, so up to 2 cheap rerolls (~400 ticks, no travel) before falling back to a walk beats walking every time) and measured ~98.75 hay/tick steady state, a ~77% throughput gain. 010 builds this into a real terminating driver and runs it for score -- if it lands near the ~02:47 projection, it becomes the new champion at ~1.2x off the leader instead of ~2.1x. See experiments/hay_single/00{1..9}/result.md and queue.md.
